question: Does routing learning from human text through the owner's own shared recurrent core, instead of through a readout on frozen features, produce a larger and more transferable language gain at equal exposure?
final_split_rule: Sealed. Opened once, after the schedule and every repair are frozen and after all development selection is complete. Never used to tune.

arms.name: blocked
arms.core: inherited, frozen; adapter held at zero output
arms.role: blocked-update control and the Stage 30 frozen-feature contract

arms.name: disconnected
arms.role: control only; never saved as a descendant

no_update_parent: the step-0 checkpoint of the connected arm, which reproduces the restored owner exactly

stages.name: definitions
stages.objective: next-token prediction over a human lexicographer's definitions

stages.name: grammar-and-sentences
stages.objective: sentence structure and parts of speech, rehearsing definitions

stages.name: argument-and-dialogue
stages.objective: extended human argument and dialogue, rehearsing earlier material

stages.name: mathematics-and-science
stages.objective: mathematical and scientific exposition, rehearsing everything earlier

mixing: explicit round-robin across the stage's declared sources, one example per source per turn

failure_rules.no_progress: three consecutive batches with no usable example ends the stage with a recorded NO_PROGRESS failure
failure_rules.unexposed_source: a stage consuming zero examples from a declared source is recorded DECLARED_SOURCE_NOT_EXPOSED
failure_rules.unavailable_evaluation: an evaluation that cannot run returns UNAVAILABLE with counts and a reason, never a score, and never qualifies or selects

acceptance.connection_supported_if: connected beats blocked on held-out dev mean next-token NLL at equal steps, and on descartes transfer
acceptance.connection_rejected_if: blocked matches or beats connected; this is reported as a rejection of the shared-core connection for language
acceptance.protection_supported_if: every exact-mathematics, field and intervention case of the declared 33-task retained suite returns an answer identical to the baseline record after teaching

untouched_for_later_comparison: the final split is opened once by this run; the transfer source and the 39 practical examples remain available unmodified, and no cohort is consumed beyond what this protocol declares
